name: Komaki Ikuno
source:
[url=/c15062]Manaka[/url]'s younger sister. In To Heart 2, she has a chronic illness that keeps her in the hospital. In Another Days, she moves about outside of hospital, including in school, on a wheelchair for most of her story unlike in "To Heart 2".
